# Noir & Co. — Atelier Documentation & Catalogue

> Complete brand philosophy, product categories, atelier craftsmanship standards, and operational client care policies.

## Brand Overview
Noir & Co. is a luxury retail and atelier brand creating elevated wardrobe essentials, crafted accessories, and refined homeware. Every piece is sourced responsibly and designed to endure across seasons.

## Primary Architecture & Sections
- [Storefront](/): Curated editorial landing, new season arrivals, and highlights
- [Catalogue](/store): Comprehensive shopping catalogue with real-time stock status, pricing, and category filters
- [Collections](/collections): Capsule edits and limited releases
- [Search](/search): Fast client search across entire collection catalog
- [Shopping Bag](/cart): Secure cart management and order checkout
- [Mobile Application](/download/app): Direct install for native iOS and Android experience

## Client Care Policies
- [Atelier Heritage & Craft](/about): Sourcing ethics, organic materials, and artisan partnerships
- [Frequently Asked Questions](/faq): Global shipping timelines, customs, duties, and order management
- [Track Order](/track-order): Live courier dispatch tracking and status updates
- [Size Guide](/size-guide): Detailed measurements, international conversion charts, and tailoring notes
- [Returns & Exchanges](/returns): 30-day return policy and exchange protocol
- [Shipping Guidelines](/shipping): Insured worldwide courier delivery standards
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Commercial terms of sale, governance, and consumer rights
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Data encryption, strict confidentiality, and cookie consent governance
- [Client Concierge](/contact): Direct contact channels and dedicated client service
